metadata.name: spin-half Carter atlas status
metadata.warning: This records chart-family status only; it is not a Kerr proof certificate.

chart_families.name: polar_L_equals_zero
remaining_obstructions: extend the two-sided polar lambda seed tube beyond |lambda| <= 1/6000 and thicken the radial seed interval into a complete rational angular-torus neighborhood
derive denominator certificates for all full polar chart formulas used outside the seed tube
extend the seed-level polar overlap policy to every polar chart in the full angular-torus atlas

chart_families.name: equatorial_Q_equals_zero
remaining_obstructions: extend the local equatorial eta <= 1/1024 and zeta <= 1/48 seed tubes to complete rational angular-torus neighborhoods
derive denominator certificates for all full equatorial chart formulas used outside the seed tube
extend the seed-level equatorial overlap policy to every equatorial chart in the full angular-torus atlas

chart_families.name: zero_spin_schwarzschild_limit
remaining_obstructions: extend the local |a|/M <= 1/64, |sigma| <= 1 blow-up box to a complete small-spin trapped-set cover
prove full overlap certificates between the small-spin blow-up cover and the nonzero-spin Carter atlas
quantify uniformity of the transition constants on fixed subextremal spin intervals approaching zero

chart_families.name: near_extremal_uniformity
remaining_obstructions: track constants as a/M approaches one
separate fixed-subextremal certificates from uniform-to-extremality claims
prove degeneration bounds for the trapped radial-Hessian scale
